data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Akul means 'immortal' or 'undying'. Derived from the root word 'akula', which means 'deathless'. This name is associated with eternal life and invincibility, as well as the strength and courage needed to overcome obstacles. The name Akul carries the meaning “Immortal, undying” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akul usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, undying and live with faith, good character and purpose.
